title: A system that persists must minimize its free energy

statements.text: A self-organizing system can only persist by occupying a limited set of preferred states and resisting dispersion. Any ergodic random dynamical system with a Markov blanket must therefore model its external states and act on them, so that self-organization, and any form of homeostasis, can be cast as minimizing variational free energy, or self-evidencing.

sources.quote: self-organization—and implicitly any form of homoeostasis—can be cast as minimizing free energy (or, more simply, self-evidencing)
any self-organizing system must minimize its own free energy and therefore must engage in active inference
